title: Admissibility criteria for convex integration fan solutions and contact discontinuities in the Euler equation
summary: For piecewise constant fan subsolutions to the isentropic Euler equations, the entropy and action rates of any associated convex integration solution, relative to a common reference solution, depend only on the fan and are computed explicitly. Moreover, these explicit expressions may be decomposed into a kinetic energy mismatch and an internal energy mismatch, from which we characterize agreement of Dafermos' entropy rate criterion with action rate criteria.
